panels.title: Welcome to Enchanted Star Realms Online
panels.body: ESRO is a persistent world where runners navigate the frontier, build alliances, and carve out their legacy. Your handle, skills, and faction ties define who you are. You are about to register a new identity on the network.

panels.title: The Frontier
panels.body: Beyond the safe zones, routes shift and danger lurks. Use OPS to run expeditions and train skills. Check CONTRACTS for faction jobs. SOCIAL keeps your party and friends in sync.

panels.title: Your Identity
panels.body: You will choose a lineage that shapes your natural abilities, and a courier role that defines your specialty. Together they determine your starting stats and how you contribute to your party.
